scope: P3 reboot observer managed-service health source and fixture verification
changes: Native service health derives from managed runit status, fixed definition identity, managed config syntax, and managed loopback SSH banner.
Boot observations persist managed service evidence and listener correlation as explicit enum fields.
Schema-v1 fields are additive and optional for compatibility; runtime validates them when present.
Degraded or unknown managed health adds an explicit observation error; malformed enum input fails with a controlled recovery error.

fixture_cases: generic sshd present with managed service stopped -> degraded
managed service verified and loopback banner -> ready_unqualified
listener correlation unknown and authenticated connectivity not tested remain explicit

limitations: No physical reboot test or Termux:Boot delivery test was run.
Listener PID correlation remains unknown when platform denies socket ownership inspection.
A loopback SSH banner does not prove authenticated connectivity.
